name: Kanban Board
hint: Turn on Sample content, then drag a candidate to another stage and watch the column part for it. Or focus a card and press Space, then the arrow keys.
description: A drag-and-drop board of columns and cards. You pass `columns` (id, title, an optional WIP limit and tone) and `cards` (id, columnId, title, anything else) and draw each card with `renderCard`; moving a card reports `onMove({ cardId, fromColumnId, toColumnId, index })` and the board is controlled or uncontrolled. Lift a card and it scales up with a deeper shadow, hangs from its grab point and leans with horizontal velocity, springing upright when you stop; the cards of the column under it part on springs to open a placeholder exactly where it will land, and letting go flies it into that slot. Near the board edge it auto-scrolls, near a column's top or bottom the column scrolls. Column counts roll, WIP limits fill a row of pips and turn the header to a warning (icon and label) the moment a hover would exceed them. Reorder within a column, fold a column to a narrow strip with its count, quick-add a card inline. Full keyboard drag: Space lifts, arrows move the card between positions and columns, Space drops, Escape cancels, each step announced; every card also has a Move to… menu (M or Shift+F10). On a phone the board becomes a snap rail of columns with tabs above; long-press lifts a card and dragging to the screen edge pages to the next column. The sample content is a hiring pipeline for a Senior Product Designer.
intents: move cards between columns with keyboard
hiring pipeline board with candidate cards
usage: Use for work that moves through a fixed sequence of stages: a task board, a sales funnel, a hiring pipeline, a support queue. Pass `columns` and `cards`, own the cards with `cards` + `onMove` (apply the move and pass the new array) or start from `defaultCards`, and draw the card with `renderCard(card)` (keep it non-interactive: the card itself is the button; use `onCardClick` to open it). Keep it to three to seven columns, give the narrow stages a `limit` so bottlenecks show, pass `onAddCard` to show an add button per column, and set `loading` while the board loads. For a single ordered list without stages, use a sortable list instead.

dataProps.description: [{ id, title, shortTitle?, limit?, tone?, emptyText?, icon?, canAdd? }] in board order. limit is a WIP limit; tone is 'accent' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'danger' | 'neutral' or a series index (a dot before the title); emptyText (string, node, or [title, text]) replaces the board's emptyText for that column.

Controlled cards: [{ id, columnId, title, description?, disabled?, ...anything renderCard reads }] in board order (order within a column is array order). Pass with onMove or onCardsChange and apply the move yourself.
Uncontrolled starting cards, same shape as cards; the board then applies moves and quick-adds itself.
({ cardId, fromColumnId, toColumnId, fromIndex, index }) => void after a drop, a keyboard drop or a Move to… choice. index is the card's position in the target column after the move.
(nextCards, move) => void with the whole card array after a move (move as in onMove) or an uncontrolled quick-add (move null).

(card, { columnId, index, dragging, ghost }) => node drawn inside the card. The card wrapper stays the focusable button with the drag and keyboard model, so render no buttons or links inside. Default: title and description.
(card) => string, the card's accessible name before its column and position. Default: card.title.
(card, event) => void on a click that was not a drag, and on Enter (Space still lifts the card).

(columnId, title, card) => void from the inline add field. Shows an add button on every column (hide one with column.canAdd: false). Uncontrolled boards also append card themselves; controlled boards leave it to you.
Text of the per-column add button.
Shown in an empty column (string, node, or [title, text]); null shows nothing.
Controlled ids of folded columns. Pass with onCollapsedChange.
Uncontrolled ids of columns that start folded.
(ids) => void when a column is folded or unfolded.
You are loading the board: skeleton cards in every column, aria-busy, no dragging or adding.
A load error to show instead of the board (true shows a neutral message).
Shows a Try again button with error.
The whole board inert (out of the tab order, no drag, no menu), dimmed.
Board height (px number or CSS length). Default: 640px desktop, the viewport less the header on a phone.
Heading above the board; also the board's accessible name (pass aria-label instead when there is no visible title; default name "Board").
A line under the title.
Show the sample hiring pipeline (only when no columns or cards are passed).
The root element.
